correctness.rationale: Starting from the source characteristic equation, the common-delay substitution gives the exact factorization \((\lambda e^{\lambda\tau})^2+P(\lambda e^{\lambda\tau})+Q=0\). Zero-delay hyperbolic stability yields \(P,Q>0\), so the two quadratic roots lie in the open left half-plane. For each scalar factor, all imaginary crossings are determined exactly by modulus and phase; the first crossing produces the stated piecewise \(\tau_c\). Differentiation gives \(\operatorname{Re}(d\lambda/d\tau)=\omega^2/(1+\omega^2\tau^2)>0\) at every simple imaginary root, so stability is lost at the first crossing and never regained. The repeated-root case is explicitly separated. The packaged verifier reproduces the source Figure 2 threshold and checks the characteristic residual at the crossing.
